# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000-$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s public identity is not simply that of an AI vendor: it is a public benefit corporation founded around reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI. That raises the bar for ecosystem deployment. Partner-led implementation must
preserve product quality, security, and responsible-use expectations while still moving at enterprise speed.

The operating tension is repeatability versus control: turning a fast-growing cloud, technology, and services ecosystem into a scalable deployment channel without allowing customer experience, technical rigor, or safety positioning to
fragment across partners.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a hybrid frontier-AI platform and enterprise product company, with a research-and-safety-led identity and a growing commercial distribution model around Claude.

Its dominant motion combines direct product adoption with ecosystem reach. Claude is positioned as an AI assistant for complex knowledge work, data analysis, coding, and problem solving; the partner model extends that value into customer
environments where services firms and technology providers shape implementation.

The central operating challenge is to translate a differentiated model and safety posture into practical enterprise outcomes. That requires architectures and delivery patterns that partners can reuse, teach, support, and sell without
reducing Claude to an interchangeable model endpoint.

Anthropic was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in San Francisco. Its public-benefit-corporation structure and stated focus on AI safety distinguish its market posture from companies that lead principally with consumer scale,
advertising, or infrastructure volume.

deployment design, governance, user workflows, and measurable adoption.
